description_en: Enables or disables a custom resolution policy of the current account by policy ID without modifying the CIDR blocks, lines, or rule content. Disabled CIDR block policies still participate in cross-policy overlap checks. To release a scope, update the scope or delete the policy. After the operation succeeds, you can call SdnsGetRuleCategory to verify the status. Actual resolution takes effect after configuration propagation
description_zh: 根据策略 Id 启用或停用当前账号的自定义解析策略，不修改地址段、线路或规则内容。停用的地址段策略仍参与跨策略重叠检查；需要释放范围时应更新范围或删除策略。成功后可调用 SdnsGetRuleCategory 核对 Status，实际解析需等待配置传播
name: SdnsSwitchRuleCategory

parameters.help_en: The policy ID of the current account. This parameter is required. You can obtain the ID from the response of CreateSdnsRuleCategory or the list returned by SdnsListRuleCategories. Use a decimal string to avoid precision loss of large integers
parameters.help_zh: 当前账号的策略 Id，必须提供。可从 CreateSdnsRuleCategory 的 Id 或 SdnsListRuleCategories 的列表中获取；使用十进制字符串，避免大整数精度丢失
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: Required. A value of true enables the policy (Status=1), and a value of false disables the policy (Status=0). Disabling the policy does not delete the configuration or release the occupied CIDR blocks. Actual resolution takes effect after configuration propagation
parameters.help_zh: 必须提供。true 表示启用（Status=1），false 表示停用（Status=0）。停用不删除配置，也不释放地址段的占用。实际解析需等待配置传播
parameters.name: enable

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot API call issues. It is not the policy ID
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，用于排查调用问题，不是策略 Id
